context_purpose: A small rental shop wants to rent a scooter safely and be able to recover losses if a foreign visitor leaves the country or damages the vehicle.

norm_violation_today.reason: Passport and permit images kept indefinitely on a shop owner's phone and in chat apps exceed what the one-off rental check needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The shop cannot get a contact or identity to chase fines, damage or unpaid costs after the renter leaves; a deposit would still be needed.

transmission_check.reason: Shops collect the documents for their own risk management, though a driving-licence check may be expected by regulators, and I cannot confirm whether a copy is mandated.

context_purpose: A volunteer relief-point organiser wants to confirm a nurse's licence is valid before letting them handle residents' medical care.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full ID and licence photos posted in group chats go well beyond the good-standing fact and spread across unrelated groups with unknown retention.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the organiser only needs current good standing, though informal personal trust and speed are lost.

transmission_check.reason: Volunteers are checked informally to protect residents, with no known duty to hold a licence copy.

context_purpose: Existing flatmates want to judge whether a stranger is safe and reliable to share a home with.

norm_violation_today.reason: A criminal record certificate and ID scans forwarded among three private individuals and stored in chats go beyond what a roommate decision needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Tenants cannot assess rent-paying ability or identity, and a not-on-list bit may not match the broader safety judgement they want.

transmission_check.reason: No legal duty compels tenants to collect the documents; it is a private peer choice.

context_purpose: A hot-spring hotel wants to apply its bath-access and tattoo-age rules at check-in.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full ID photocopy kept on a paper sheet far exceeds one eligibility bit.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Gender-based eligibility is binary and a register flag cannot handle trans or non-binary guests; staff also lose a fallback for disputes.

transmission_check.reason: Guest registration at accommodation may be required by regulation, and I cannot confirm whether a copy of ID is mandated.

context_purpose: A private landlord wants assurance that a prospective tenant is currently employed and likely to pay rent.

norm_violation_today.reason: ARC, passport, contract and payslip kept in a LINE chat far exceed a current-employment signal.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A permit-status flag does not show salary level or the rental-filing details the landlord may separately need.

transmission_check.reason: The tenant volunteers documents for a deposit discount, but I cannot confirm whether tenancy filing rules require ARC details.

context_purpose: A baseball club wants to admit ticket holders quickly while preventing resale and duplicate entry.

norm_violation_today.reason: Face templates, names and purchase history kept after the game for marketing and fraud screening exceed what entry needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The club loses a central record for banning abusers and for marketing, and the device-side face match is only as strong as the phone.

transmission_check.reason: Entry control and anti-resale are the club's own business choice, with no known legal duty to keep templates.

context_purpose: A volunteer coordination centre wants to confirm that rostered nurses are currently licensed before staffing shelters.

norm_violation_today.reason: Employer, ward, home district and phone in a shared spreadsheet exceed the licence-currency check and expose nurses to neighbours.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Coordinators still need contact details and scheduling information, which a pure licence proof does not provide.

transmission_check.reason: Health authorities may require staffing records for deployed nurses, and I cannot confirm what must be retained.

context_purpose: Sitting tenants want assurance that a sublet applicant has been vetted without reading the applicant's full record.

norm_violation_today.reason: The committee keeps copies of strangers' ID and criminal record certificates it has no reason to hold.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Tenants rely on a committee whose authority for criminal checks is doubtful, and a not-on-list bit may not match their broader concerns.

transmission_check.reason: No known duty compels the check, and I cannot confirm whether a committee may lawfully run one for private persons.
